messages.content: [Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, Melanie! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.
[Date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy. Great that you're prioritizing self-care.

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family is gonna be so lucky to have you!

[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Mel! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality. And here's one of the adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic.
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, that agency looks great! What made you pick it?
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: I chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity and support really spoke to me.
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: That's great, Caroline! Loving the inclusivity and support. Anything you're excited for in the adoption process?
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words really mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.
[Date: 1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023] [Melanie]: No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Melanie! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! I talked about my transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community. It was great to see their reactions. It made me reflect on how far I've come since I started transitioning three years ago.

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you. Sounds like your event was amazing! I'm so proud of you for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community. You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Mel! Your backing really means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. I shared my own journey, the struggles I had and how much I've developed since coming out. It was wonderful to see how the audience related to what I said and how it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are so necessary and I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline, you're doing an awesome job of inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it and see how you're positively affecting so many. Talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, and you're so brave to speak up for the trans community. Keep up the great work!

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing our experiences isn't always easy, but I feel it's important to help promote understanding and acceptance. I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, and I want to pass it on to others. By sharing our stories, we can build a strong, supportive community of hope.

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Yeah, Caroline! It takes courage to talk about our own stories. But it's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. We all have our different paths, but if we share them, we show people that they're not alone. Our stories can be so inspiring and encouraging to others who are facing the same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story and give others hope. We all have unique paths, and by working together we can build a more inclusive and understanding world. I'm going to keep using my voice to make a change and lift others up. And you're part of that!

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline, for letting me join your journey. I'm so proud to be part of the difference you're making. Let's keep motivating and helping each other out as we journey through life. We can make a real impact together!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Yeah Mel, let's spread love and understanding! Thanks for the support and encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Yes, Caroline! We can do it. Your courage is inspiring. I want to be couragous for my family- they motivate me and give me love. What motivates you?

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Mel! My friends, family and mentors are my rocks – they motivate me and give me the strength to push on. Here's a pic from when we met up last week!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, that photo is great! How long have you had such a great support system?

[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Yeah, I'm really lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, I've known these friends for 4 years, since I moved from my home country. Their love and help have been so important especially after that tough breakup. I'm super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: I'm lucky to have my husband and kids; they keep me motivated.
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, what an amazing family pic! How long have you been married?
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: 5 years already! Time flies- feels like just yesterday I put this dress on! Thanks, Caroline!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Congrats, Melanie! You both looked so great on your wedding day! Wishing you many happy years together!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. Our family and moments make it all worth it.
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Looks like you had a great day! How was it? You all look so happy!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: It so fun! We played games, ate good food, and just hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Sounds great, Mel! Glad you had a great time. Cherish the moments - they're the best!
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Absolutely, Caroline! I cherish time with family. It's when I really feel alive and happy.
[Date: 7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023] [Caroline]: I 100% agree, Mel. Hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings so much happiness. Those moments really make me thankful. Family is everything.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Melanie! Long time no talk! A lot's been going on in my life! Take a look at this.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love the necklace, any special meaning to it?

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength. It's like a reminder of my roots and all the love and support I get from my family.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: That's gorgeous, Caroline! It's awesome what items can mean so much to us, right? Got any other objects that you treasure, like that necklace?

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Yep, Melanie! I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. The pattern and colors are awesome-- it reminds me of art and self-expression.

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: That sounds great, Caroline! It's awesome having stuff around that make us think of good connections and times. Actually, I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Sounds great, Mel. Glad you made some new family mems. How was it? Anything fun?

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: It was an awesome time, Caroline! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike. The view from the top was amazing! The 2 younger kids love nature. It was so special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like that are so special. Glad y'all had such a great time.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! Family time matters to me. What's up with you lately?
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Lately, I've been looking into counseling and mental health as a career. I want to help people who have gone through the same things as me.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Sounds great! What kind of counseling and mental health services do you want to persue?

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: I'm still figuring out the details, but I'm thinking of working with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health. Last Friday, I went to an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop and it was really enlightening. They talked about different therapeutic methods and how to best work with trans people. Seeing how passionate these pros were about making a safe space for people like me was amazing.

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Woah, Caroline, it sounds like you're doing some impressive work. It's inspiring to see your dedication to helping others. What motivated you to pursue counseling?

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie. It really mattered. My own journey and the support I got made a huge difference. Now I want to help people go through it too. I saw how counseling and support groups improved my life, so I started caring more about mental health and understanding myself. Now I'm passionate about creating a safe, inviting place for people to grow.

[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! You've gained so much from your own experience. Your passion and hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, you're making a big impact!
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot.
[Date: 10:37 am on 27 June, 2023] [Melanie]: Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you really care about.

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Since we last spoke, some big things have happened. Last week I went to an LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone was so happy and it made me feel like I belonged. It showed me how much our community has grown, it was amazing!

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline, sounds like the parade was an awesome experience! It's great to see the love and support for the LGBTQ+ community. Congrats! Has this experience influenced your goals at all?

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Mel! It really motivated me for sure. Talking to the community made me want to use my story to help others too - I'm still thinking that counseling and mental health is the way to go. I'm super excited to give back.

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! That's great! I just signed up for a pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative. Have you found any activities that make you feel the same way?
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, Melanie! I'm getting creative too, just learning the piano. What made you try pottery?
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: I'm a big fan of pottery - the creativity and skill is awesome. Plus, making it is so calming. Look at this!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: That bowl is gorgeous! The black and white design looks so fancy. Did you make it?
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! Yeah, I made this bowl in my class. It took some work, but I'm pretty proud of it.
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Nice job! You really put in the work and it definitely shows. Your creativity looks great!

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! Your kind words mean a lot. Pottery is a huge part of my life, not just a hobby - it helps me express my emotions. Clay is incredible, it brings me so much joy!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, Mel, I'm so stoked for you that art is helping you express yourself and bring you joy! Keep it up!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! I'm excited to see where pottery takes me. Anything coming up you're looking forward to?

[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks Mel! I'm going to a transgender conference this month. I'm so excited to meet other people in the community and learn more about advocacy. It's gonna be great!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Sounds awesome, Caroline! Have a great time and learn a lot. Have fun!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Cool, thanks Mel! Can't wait. I'll keep ya posted. Bye!
[Date: 1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Bye, Caroline! Can't wait to hear about it. Have fun and stay safe!
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Mel! Long time no talk. Lots has been going on since then!
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey Caroline! Missed you. Anything new? Spill the beans!

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Since our last chat, I've been looking into counseling or mental health work more. I'm passionate about helping people and making a positive impact. It's tough, but really rewarding too. Anything new happening with you?

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: That's awesome, Caroline! Congrats on following your dreams. Yesterday I took the kids to the museum - it was so cool spending time with them and seeing their eyes light up!
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Melanie, that's a great pic! That must have been awesome. What were they so stoked about?
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: They were stoked for the dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals and the bones were so cool. It reminds me why I love being a mom.
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Being a mom is awesome. I'm creating a library for when I have kids. I'm really looking forward to reading to them and opening up their minds.
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Sounds great! What kind of books you got in your library?

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books, all of that. What's a favorite book you remember from your childhood?
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: I loved reading "Charlotte's Web" as a kid. It was so cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make a difference.

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, that's great! It sure shows how important friendship and compassion are. It's made me appreciate how lucky I am to have my friends and family helping with my transition. They make all the difference. We even had a picnic last week!
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: That's a gorgeous photo, Caroline! Wow, the love around you is awesome. How have your friends and fam been helping you out with your transition?

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! This support network has been amazing. They've been there for me every step of the way giving me love, guidance, and acceptance. I couldn't have done it without them.
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! It's great you have people to support you, that's really awesome!

[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Caroline]: I'm so lucky to have such a great support system around me. Their love and encouragement has really helped me accept and grow into my true self. They've been instrumental in my transition.
[Date: 8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Glad you have support, Caroline! Unconditional love is so important. Here's a pic of my family camping at the beach. We love it, it brings us closer!

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Mel, great to chat with you again! So much has happened since we last spoke - I went to an LGBTQ conference two days ago and it was really special. I got the chance to meet and connect with people who've gone through similar journeys. It was such a welcoming environment and I felt totally accepted. I'm really thankful for this amazing community - it's shown me how important it is to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline, that sounds awesome! So glad you felt accepted and supported. Events like these are great for reminding us of how strong community can be!

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Yeah, it's true! Having people who back you makes such a huge difference. It's great to see how far LGBTQ rights have come, but there's still plenty of progress to be made. I wanna help make a difference.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline. We've come so far, but there's more to do. Your drive to help is awesome! What's your plan to pitch in?

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks, Mell! I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! You're so inspiring for wanting to help others with their mental health. What's pushing you to keep going forward with it?

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system. So, I started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Caroline, so glad you got the support! Your experience really brought you to where you need to be. You're gonna make a huge difference! This book I read last year reminds me to always pursue my dreams, just like you are doing!🌟

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks so much, Mel! Seeing this pic just made me appreciate my love of reading even more. Books guide me, motivate me and help me discover who I am. They're a huge part of my journey, and this one's reminding me to keep going and never give up!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! Books have such an awesome power! Which one has been your favorite guide?

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: I loved "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. It's a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family. It made me feel connected and gave me a lot of hope for my own path. Highly recommend it for sure!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: That sounds awesome! What did you take away from it to use in your life?

[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: It taught me self-acceptance and how to find support. It also showed me that tough times don't last - hope and love exist. Pets bring so much joy too, though.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Caroline, those lessons are great - self-acceptance and finding support are key. Plus pets are awesome for joy and comfort, can't agree more!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: That's so nice! What pet do you have?
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: We've got a pup and a kitty. That's the dog, and here's our cat! They brighten up our day and always make us smile.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Ah, they're adorable! What are their names? Pets sure do bring so much joy to us!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Luna and Oliver! They are so sweet and playful - they really liven up the house! Just got some new shoes, too!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Love that purple color! For walking or running?
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! These are for running. Been running longer since our last chat - a great way to destress and clear my mind.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow! What got you into running?
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: I've been running farther to de-stress, which has been great for my headspace.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Cool, Melanie! Running can really boost your mood. Keep it up!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! This has been great for my mental health. I'm gonna keep it up.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Awesome, Melanie! Mental health's a priority, so make sure you take care of yourself.
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Caroline, thanks! Mental health is important to me, and it's made such an improvement!
[Date: 4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Glad it helped ya, Melanie!
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Hey Mel, what's up? Been a busy week since we talked.

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Hey Caroline, it's been super busy here. So much since we talked! Last Fri I finally took my kids to a pottery workshop. We all made our own pots, it was fun and therapeutic!
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, Mel! Sounds like you and the kids had a blast. How'd they like it?

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: The kids loved it! They were so excited to get their hands dirty and make something with clay. It was special to watch their creativity and imagination come to life, they made this!

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Aww, that's so sweet! That cup is so cute. It's awesome to see how kids show their personalities through art. What other creative projects do you do with them, besides pottery?
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: We love painting together lately, especially nature-inspired ones. Here's our latest work from last weekend.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow Mel, that painting's amazing! The colors are so bold and it really highlights the beauty of nature. Y'all work on it together?

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Thanks, Caroline! We both helped with the painting - it was great bonding over it and chatting about nature. We found these lovely flowers. Appreciating the small things in life, too.

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: That photo is stunning! So glad you bonded over our love of nature. Last Friday I went to a council meeting for adoption. It was inspiring and emotional - so many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need. It made me even more determined to adopt.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, Caroline, way to go! Your future fam will get a kick out of having you. What do you think of these?

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Thanks Melanie - love the blue vase in the pic! Blue's my fave, it makes me feel relaxed. Sunflowers mean warmth and happiness, right? While roses stand for love and beauty? That's neat. What do flowers mean to you?

[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Flowers bring joy. They represent growth, beauty and reminding us to appreciate the small moments. They were an important part of my wedding decor and always remind me of that day.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: It must have been special at your wedding. I wish I had known you back then!
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: It was amazing, Caroline. The day was full of love and joy. Everyone we love was there to celebrate us - it was really special.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, what a great day! Glad everyone could make it. What was your favorite part?
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Marrying my partner and promising to be together forever was the best part.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Melanie]: Wow, looks awesome! Did you join in?
[Date: 1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023] [Caroline]: Yes, I did. It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory.
